verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents native Model Context Protocol support that lets AI assistants interact directly with stores, so users can operate a store in natural language through an external MCP-capable assistant. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface in the dashboard or mobile app; the NL layer depends on a third-party AI client. Missing for 10: a first-party in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which store operations are exposed via MCP, hands-on or independent corroboration that NL-driven store management works.
